caption: This drawing depicts a single object that resembles a candle holder with a large, fan-shaped or shell-like reflector behind it. The holder portion is a small, cylindrical form set inside a shallow, round base with scalloped edges. Extending upward and attached to the base is a broad, curved arm supporting the large reflector. The reflector is prominently textured with radial and concentric lines, suggesting a ribbed or segmented surface. The color of the drawing is monochromatic, rendered in shades of gray with areas of light and shadow to indicate depth and form, set against a plain, light background. The artist’s name, Julius Bellamy, is signed in small letters on the bottom right corner.
title: Candle Sconce
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
